Parent rename and leaf symlinks cannot redirect publication to a replacement directory/alias target.

Native output owners hold repository/output leases, drain job/Quit accounting and cancel on initiating-window closure or workspace retirement. Final publication shares the MainActor owner check/rename acceptance turn.

Normal Graph retains interactive filters and owning preferences.

Standalone containing-reference windows retain independent input and source layouts/pickers; captured repository/access consumers handle Log, Browse, compare, unified and navigation. Unified handoffs retain window cancellation and original preferences.
